facts.video_statistics_description: Average per-day, per-scenario video statistics over one month; counts is the number of component statistics.
facts.causal_validity_for_april_22_to_28_valid: not established because the documentation does not state the one-month window's endpoints or cutoff relative to each scored impression
facts.pure_sequence_caveat: The official documentation says KuaiRand-Pure has incomplete sequential logs and recommends 27K/1K when rigorous sequential logs are required.
facts.random_intervention_mechanism: A normally recommended list item is replaced by a uniformly sampled item from the 7,583-item pool with a fixed undisclosed probability.
